description: handle_message_set create loop lines 405-416 contains repeated pattern: if let Some(x) = val { field = Some(x) }. When val already has type Option<T> and no transformation occurs, this is equivalent to field = val and clippy::manual_map flags it. Affected lines: 405-407 (reply_to), 408-410 (thread_root_id), 414-416 (burn_on_read). Should be: msg.reply_to = reply_to; msg.thread_root_id = thread_root_id; msg.burn_on_read = burn_on_read;
title: message.rs create: if-let Some passthrough should be direct assign
